name: zclass_sequence_render_traverse
description: zClass_Sequence::RenderTraverse dispatches the active sequence entry when the sequence is visible and active.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for sequence render traversal; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass render traversal source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja/source review validates visible and active gates, transform-dirty clearing, cull result propagation, clip-mask stack push/pop, active entry dispatch, and bounds-context restoration.
The native render traversal dispatch smoke verifies dispatch into sequence traversal and active-entry child rendering with stack restoration.
